# RunFood API

> API pública de RunFood (POS on-premise para restaurantes en Ecuador): pedidos, facturación, catálogos y webhooks salientes firmados con HMAC.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://runfoodapp.github.io/api-docs/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for RunFood API, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://runfoodapp.github.io/api-docs/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for RunFood API

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
